title: fix(app-shell): a read-only flow edge inspector says why its controls are disabled

_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbHnTjnh5M3LadfnDnbjjaUP)_

Fixes #29077

Claim: issue comment 6572861977 (branch `claude/project-thread-1r2gue`, session `session_01QsR2jU7NRnC2NpRec6yEYE`).

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:Studio 流程画布上，只读包里选中一条连线后，连线属性栏现在会说明控件为什么是灰的：悬停任一灰色控件弹出原因，键盘 Tab 能停在属性栏上，读屏把原因当描述读出。与节点属性栏(#28985)同一做法，两边共用一个新的共享组件，不再各写一份。
- **为什么改**:宿主早已把「只读软件包」的原因传给连线属性栏，但它没读，控件灰着却什么也不说;平台清单 `ux-conventions.disabled-control-reason` 在这个面上仍判失败。
- **风险与回滚**:低。只有「只读且宿主给了原因」时才多包一层可聚焦分组;不传原因的宿主(如元数据编辑页)与可写状态完全不变。节点属性栏改用共享组件后 DOM 不变，其原有测试未改即通过。回滚即还原本 PR。
- **先看**:`_shared.tsx` 新增的 `InspectorReadOnlyReason`;`FlowEdgeInspector.tsx` 末尾的包裹;`FlowNodeInspector.tsx` 换成共享组件的那一段。
- **两分钟验证**:在 `ui/` 下运行 `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/FlowEdgeInspector.readOnlyReason-29077.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.automationsReadOnly-11124.test.tsx`,预期 2 个文件、17 个测试全绿。
- **需要你做的**:无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`InspectorReadOnlyReason`** (new, `inspectors/_shared.tsx`; not reachable from the `@object-ui/app-shell` entry). The reason group `FlowNodeInspector` drew inline since #28985, lifted so both flow inspectors draw one: a `role="group"` named by the element the panel edits, `tabIndex={0}`, `aria-describedby` an `sr-only` copy of the reason, `data-disabled-reason`, and the trigger of a tooltip that shows it. It renders its children bare unless `readOnly` and the reason is non-blank.
- **`FlowEdgeInspector`** now reads `readOnlyReason` and wraps its panel in that group, named by the connection the way its title is (each end by its node's name, never an id). The missing-edge empty state has no controls and stays bare.
- **`FlowNodeInspector`** uses the shared group with the same DOM, test id and name it had; its own `useId` and tooltip imports go.
- Studio's Automations pillar already hands every flow inspector the reason (#28985), so no host changes. `ResourceEditPage` still passes none (#29079).

## Tests

- **New: `FlowEdgeInspector.readOnlyReason-29077.test.tsx`, 6 cases** on an approval's out-edge (so the Approval branch picker draws too): read-only with a reason makes the panel a tab stop named by the connection and described by the reason, holding every disabled control (at least six); hovering the disabled "Remove connection" opens the tooltip; Tab lands on the panel and opens it. Controls: no reason gives no group and no tab stop; a blank reason counts as none; a writable panel ignores a reason and its controls are live.
- **Changed: `StudioDesignSurface.automationsReadOnly-11124.test.tsx`**, one new case: through the real pillar, `FlowPreview` and `FlowInspector`, clicking the start → end connection on a read-only package opens the edge inspector inside the described group with the package's reason.
- **Red on main.** With the three source files restored from base `0d6d4061`, the two edge files plus the #28985 node file ran 4 failed, 19 passed: the three edge reason cases and the host edge case fail (no `flow-edge-readonly-reason` group), every control and every node case passes.

## Acceptance notes

- Other surfaces still inline the same group (Studio's field rail, the validation-rule editor, the flow ledger switch, the field inspector's per-control locks); they are not moved here. Each can adopt `InspectorReadOnlyReason` when next touched.
- The tooltip also opens when hovering the header's close button, since the whole panel is the trigger; the node inspector behaves the same.
